profile.headline: Freelance Web Developer and Artist at N/A

positions.title: Freelance Web Developer/Programmer
positions.description: Knowledge building websites with HTML, CSS, Javascript, React; knowledge of Git and Github, knowledge of Python; knowledge of Oracle Database Management and Oracle Database Design, SQL. Experience managing social media for fundraisers/events

positions.title: Artist
positions.description: I am a lifelong artist who has experience with drawing and painting in charcoal, pencil, pastels, watercolor, oil, and I specialize in acrylics. I draw and paint portraits of people and animals, landscapes, and abstract designs. I have had my work displayed in two art shows with BECA Gallery in both New Orleans, LA and Albuquerque, New Mexico with artwork sold in this show. I have created and illustrated a series to help domestic workers in Hong Kong understand their rights for a local NGO. I had private art lessons with artists and art teachers Provie Smith and Jackie Goode and had my student artwork displayed in Grisham-Cornell Gallery. I am also a photographer who is a Shutterstock contributor

positions.title: Host
positions.description: Through the company DogVacay, I started my own pet-sitting business where I cared for clients' pets while they were away. I had many repeat and loyal clients, and only positive reviews. Really the most fun job ever

positions.title: Job Mentor
positions.description: Mentor clients new to the United States on how to go about seeking employment in this country. Teach clients how to write resumes and cover letters, provide clients with interviewing skills, and give general job search advice. Assist with other items as needed, such as finding housing, educational opportunities, understanding cultural practices, e.g. mentored refugee from Sri Lanka-assisted with job applications, community college applications, FAFSA application, and graduate school admissions process, as well as English language and writing skills. I also screened and did intake for clients at immigration workshops.

positions.title: AmeriCorps Fellowship
positions.description: Researched community demographics to assist in organization's outreach efforts. Recruited volunteers for events and projects, including corporate volunteers. Assisted in planning volunteer recognition event. Worked with a team to develop volunteer advice packet. Worked with team to create a plan to implement Girl Scout activities in underserved areas. Launched a Girl Scout Disability Awareness Committee to provide support to Girl Scout troops. Training: Volunteer Management Certification

positions.title: Publishing Assistant
positions.description: Provided support to manage finances and editorial boards of several major medical journals.  Coordinated activities with publishers, editors, authors, societies and other editorial staff. Composed weekly online medical newsletter. Planned events such as editorial board meetings, including overseas meetings. Handled contracts, financial budgets, and payments for journals. Conducted online research for publisher presentations.

positions.title: Consultant
positions.description: Consulting project with the United Nations through New School University: Evaluated existing conflict assessment methodologies, explored respective strengths and weaknesses of these methodologies, and determined how different actors translated results of these assessments into effective conflict prevention and/or peacebuilding strategies and policies.

company.name: United Nations Department of Political Affairs

positions.title: Caseworker (Graduate Internship)
positions.description: Hong Kong NGO, worked with foreign domestic workers in Hong Kong; conducted interviews with domestic workers who came into office for legal advice, worked on their cases to prepare necessary documentation, such as statements, letters to employers and labor officers, and affidavits, as well as briefings to prepare workers for labor court and/or negotiations with former employers and employment agencies. Created and illustrated series to help domestic workers understand their rights.

positions.title: Consultant
positions.description: Created proposal for fundraising, redesign of marketing materials, budget, and staffing needs.

positions.title: Overseas Volunteer
positions.description: Photographed the organization's projects. Created community bulletin board to build awareness, pride, and solidarity within low income area that organization served. Assisted in wide variety of community service projects as needed, such as tutoring and chaperoning children.

positions.title: Overseas Volunteer
positions.description: Provided support to the marketing department. Managed databases and assisted in fundraising events.

positions.title: Program Associate
positions.description: Nonprofit work in the area of homelessness prevention-Marketed/promoted programs to assist low income individuals in Brooklyn; developed and organized financial and legal workshops for Brooklyn tenants; conducted community outreach to spread knowledge of new assistance/educational programs; gathered and graphed demographics in low income community in Brooklyn. Conducted legal and real estate research related to low income housing and secured low income apartments in NYC area. Created tenant education workbook to help low income tenants understand housing rules and regulations, especially their rights and the rights of landlords. Liased between different departments within Common Ground and with external companies. Assisted tenant rights attorney with client intake and screening.

positions.title: Bodily Injury Claims Specialist II
positions.description: Negotiated, Investigated, evaluated and settled bodily injury claims, dealt directly with claimants, as well as attorneys; monitored trials; determined insurance coverage; engaged in field assignments/investigations; liaised with different departments within company and outside companies; interacted with customers daily; caseload of 100+ claims within 8 months of start date. Training Seminar: Advanced Negotiations; Awards: Customer Service Committee Award, Sept 2004; received a Promotion within 7 months of start date;  volunteered for Liberty Mutual's annual fundraising campaign for United Way: Created, planned, organized, fundraising events; Liberty Mutual Award for Service
